newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS ASK N.TRANSVAAL TO BAT FIRST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS ASK N.TRANSVAAL TO BAT FIRST.

text.p: Northern Transvaal were asked to bat first after Griqualand West won the toss in their four-day Supersport Series match at Kimberley on Friday.
Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Cedric English, Pieter Barnard, Willie Dry, Finley Brooker, Brett Benkenstein, Wendell Bossenger, Adri Swanepoel, Garth Roe, Vaughn Walsh.
Northern Transvaal - Andre Seymore, Blaise Sommerville, Roy Pienaar, Dirk de Vos, Mike Rindel, Martin van Jaarsveld, Dan van Zyl, Mark Davies (captain), Steve Elworthy, Ivan Pistorius, Deon Kruis.
